note: Corrections to the league Obvibase register, applied by scripts/build_trade_counts.py at read time. The register is John's and is re-exported from time to time; hand-editing a derived file would be undone by the next export and would leave no record of who changed what. Each entry names the register row by its own id, says what was wrong, and cites who corrected it. Applied in order; a row whose id is absent from the export is reported, not silently skipped.

corrections.why: The register had the Machines' side right and the other side blank, against the wrong franchise. Two errors in one row: the counterparty was Big Blue, not Wookie Leaks, and TJ Hockenson came back. Entered on the league's draft day, the busiest page in the register and nine entries deep, which is where a row gets opened and never finished. The desk excluded it as a record with one side, which made the register and the itemised ledger agree exactly -- a tidy answer that was wrong. It is a real trade.
corrections.source: John, league commissioner, 21 October 2026: 'Big blue trade Hockenson to machines for Kelce, Sinnot, Now second 2027'
corrections.corroborates: The Machines send Hockenson on to The Powers of Pain later the same season (for Chuba Hubbard and Wookie Leaks' 2027 2nd), which needs him to have arrived from somewhere. He arrived here.
